steps: Build in a worktree (Sonnet minion) (45 min)
Review the diff, smoke, merge (15 min)
Restart Servex, prove on two real tasks (20 min)
Docs, mastermind skill line, finish-task (15 min)
assign.now: plan written; spawning the build minion

log.msg: before: 116 tasks in 7 days, 15 with steps (13%), 0 with estimates; 11 of 14 landed-with-steps reached the last step (79%). TaskLoop walks only ai/YYYY-MM-DD/, so it chases nothing in the sessions store.

decision.question: where the steps live
decision.chose: task.jsonl assign.steps as strings ending '(N min)'
decision.why: every reader already reads it; strings keep the board checklist working
decision.alternative: a steps section in plan.md parsed by node

experiment.try: Step runner live: estimated steps, step-prompt hook, 2x nudge in TaskLoop, Steps.mjs --report
experiment.measure: followed fully = estimated steps, every step after the first bumped on its own line, landed with an outcome (node Server/Steps.mjs --report)
experiment.result: before (7 days, 114 tasks): 16 with steps, 1 with estimates, 0 followed fully (0%). After, two real tasks: refine-parse-fix planned with Steps.mjs --plan, all 5 steps bumped, landed: followed fully; step-runner: steps 3-6 bumped, but 1-3 were set at once before the system existed, so strictly not followed fully. Rate of estimated tasks 0% -> 50% (1 of 2). The hook prompted live on a step bump; it was silent on a $VAR path, fixed in 9892d5ff3.

log.msg: build landed on worktree/step-runner (de61ef02d, 5562d6c85, proof c16ecb675); tests pass; private Servex on 8390 boots and TaskLoop ticks over the sessions store (open 9, chased 5); fresh-eyes review running

answer.reply: noted: the two-task proof and before/after happen after merge + restart (step 5); the task will not land without it
noted: merge.mjs merges commits only; the uncommitted files.jsonl churn is generated and stays out
fixed: the comment now says the nudge resets the quiet timer from the next tick (a nudge counts as a chase)
fixed: the shot note points at the brief's widths and Server/doc/review.md
noted: Heartbeat.opted_in also opts in any task whose line 1 is dated after SERVEX_HEARTBEAT_SINCE, so new spawned tasks are in by default

log.msg: merged worktree/step-runner into michael/dev (review pass); restarting Servex

restored: lines 6-23 of this file (written 16:16:56-16:22:42) were gone by 16:32 (the file was back to its committed 5 lines; cause unknown, no stash/reset in the reflog). Re-appended from my own append payloads with their original times; step 6 re-asserted below

assign.outcome:
**The Step runner is live**: a task's steps carry time estimates (`"do it (N min)"`), a hook prompts each next step at no extra turn, and the [TaskLoop](/framework/servex/doc/task-loop.md) sends one nudge when a step runs past 2× its estimate. Before: 0 of 16 tasks with steps followed fully. After, on two real tasks: 1 of 2 followed fully, and the miss is this task's own pre-system steps 1-3 ([plan.md](plan.md), the `experiment` line).

- Doc: [Servex/doc/steps.md](/framework/servex/doc/steps.md): the name, the requirements, its `steps` log
- Code: `Server/Steps.mjs` (`--plan`, `--show`, `--report`, `ui`/`base` templates), `.claude/hooks/step-prompt.mjs`, `Servex/TaskLoop.js` `nudge_step`. The TaskLoop now also walks the sessions store, which it had skipped entirely
- Proofs: two tests, a private Servex boot on 8390, and the live Servex restarted on the new code (merges 89ce0e363, 9892d5ff3)
- Skills: one line each in mastermind, minion and sub-mastermind
- Also fixed: a test script that did not parse and blocked every Servex restart (0eb3db230)
- ⚠️ Left: 15 lines of this log vanished between 16:22 and 16:32 and were restored; the cause is unknown ([note](/framework/ai/2026/10/12/a-task-log-lost-15-lines-in-the-main-tre/))
